topology.capacityScope: Conservative full deployment pool reservation; actual active processes listed separately

databaseProfile.scope: Owned local test database; PostgreSQL execution statistics exclude client/pool/network time. Cluster WAL includes all databases on this owned test instance.
databaseProfile.blockerScope: Sampled blocker statement categories and transaction age; a transaction can retain locks acquired by an earlier statement. Fixed SQL-side labels only, no query text, parameters, backend IDs or credentials retained.

stageEvidence.scope: Native image consumers drain preloaded default critical-trigger fixtures. Preparation/readiness excluded; publish, monitoring and durable outbox writes included. Automation off, no users/integrations/external providers. CPU counters include diagnostic collection. Not HTTP, representative-provider delivery, sustained-load, mixed-workload or HA certification.

cpuDelta.scope: Per-process cgroup CPU deltas over resource snapshot interval; includes diagnostic overhead. Full-stack/admission interval also includes configured preflight and warmup.
